observedElements: Directly viewed location-specific entrance photo shows Entrance 2, a triangular projecting gable/portico, two tall pale rectangular concrete columns with block bases, taupe horizontal siding, circular gable logo/window, brown brick walls with pale horizontal bands, dark-framed entry glazing, and blue storefront fascia.
Original procedural brick and stucco tiles are generated for this asset; source photos are references only and are not shipped.
estimatedElements: The portico and representative facade are placed on a long footprint edge because the reference photo has no compass bearing; this mapped side is unverified.
Overall roof height, mall wall bands, portal dimensions, gable projection, column spacing, circular window size, storefront mullion spacing, and all unseen elevations are approximate.
BMO signage seen on an adjacent wing is intentionally excluded and not treated as mall-wide branding.
